notes: 1T-DA-672 is a 1x2 HDMI v1.4 distribution amplifier (300MHz/9Gbps, HDCP 1.1, DVI 1.0 compliant via HDMI-to-DVI adapter cable — not a separate physical port), discontinued/EOL (tvONE lists MG-DA-612 as successor), so it is absent from tvONE's current live site. Desktop enclosure (1.0 x 4.0 x 5.7 in) — not rack-mountable, rackUnits omitted. Power: single external DC adapter with a locking screw-on barrel connector, closest match "dc-barrel"; exact rear-panel silkscreen for the power jack and I/O labels (e.g. whether outputs read "OUT 1/OUT 2" vs "A/B") could not be confirmed from a panel photo, so port names are inferred standard convention. Power-supply voltage conflicts across sources: the mirrored tvONE instruction manual (used as primary source here) and several AV-distributor catalog pages (Midtown Video, InfoCor, Allen Visual) state 5VDC@2.6A, while Markertek's listing states 12V — sided with the manual's verbatim spec (5VDC@2.6A) as the more authoritative figure, but flagging the discrepancy.
